relations.reason: A represented billed-revenue invoice as recorded in billing sources with source-native identifiers and metadata.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Invoice rows are source-native billing facts; truth does not depend on which diligence purpose is active.

relations.reason: A CRM commercial account record as it appears in the authoritative CRM export.
relations.purpose_independence_test: CRM account records are export facts independent of analytical purpose.

relations.reason: A company-registry legal entity row as recorded in the authoritative registry export.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Registry legal-entity rows are authoritative registry facts independent of purpose.

relations.reason: A contract or statement-of-work document with source-native identifier and counterparty naming as it appears in the markdown header.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Contract documents and identifiers exist as source artifacts regardless of diligence question.

relations.reason: Observed effective, expiry, and free-text term language for a contract document as stated in source headers.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Observed effective/expiry/term text is a mechanical source observation independent of purpose policy.

relations.reason: A numbered or titled contractual section excerpt exactly as it appears in a source contract document.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Section excerpts are verbatim source observations independent of clause-classification purposes.

relations.reason: Whether a contract is currently in force on the evaluation date according to its stated dates and term language, independent of any diligence purpose.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Whether a contract is in force on the evaluation date is a lifecycle fact with stable meaning absent any purpose threshold.

relations.reason: Whether a contract bears a specified clause kind under the analytical vocabulary requested by purposes A or C.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Clause-kind presence is classified against purpose A/C vocabularies and acquisition/obligation analytical frames.

relations.reason: Two commercially relevant identifiers denote the same legal counterparty, are confidently distinct, or remain unresolved.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Identity sameness/distinctness is resolved for purpose-driven entity threading, not as a purpose-independent world fact.

relations.reason: Whether a billed invoice can be confidently associated with a governing contract/counterparty thread for purpose A reporting.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Invoice-to-contract association is asserted for purpose A reporting joins, not as a source-native mechanical link.

relations.reason: A directed pair of purpose-B identifier strings that are comparable candidates within the same commercial relationship thread.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Directed identifier pairs for connectivity are compiled correspondence candidates, not purpose-scoped identity verdicts.

relations.reason: Invoices whose source status is open as recorded in billing data.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Open invoice status is a mechanical filter on source billing status, not a purpose policy.

relations.reason: Boolean projection of resolved contract_in_force judgments for consumer fields requiring semantic_identity active.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Boolean active projection is a mechanical view of resolved in-force judgments, not a purpose-specific active-contract rule.

relations.reason: Purpose-C dependency row asserting dependent or unresolved status for a contract/counterparty thread under the joint current-relationship and obligation test.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Dependency status applies the joint purpose-C current-relationship and obligation test.

limitations: Purpose relations (clause_presence, identity_judgment, invoice_contract_association, commercial_dependency) are not promoted into 06_world per admission policy.
contract_in_force UNRESOLVED rows are persisted in World but omitted from contract_in_force_active per vocabulary construction rule.
Prior pass dispositions carry empty grounding arrays; P6 supplies SOURCE packet and source-location groundings at assertion time.
